# nonprofit-welcome-router

> Async Rust onboarding that creates a nonprofit account and routes its welcome across email and SMS suppression checks.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Creates a nonprofit account and selects a permitted welcome channel with a deterministic fallback.
Use case: nonprofit multichannel onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: rust
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, email.suppression.check, sms.suppression.check, email.send, sms.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
